title: Adversarially Robust Detection of Harmful Online Content: A Computational Design Science Approach
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development and adversarial robustness of a harmful content detector. While the categories of content it aims to detect (hate speech, extremism) have ethical and moral dimensions, the paper itself is a study of computational design and engineering for robustness rather than an evaluation or benchmarking of moral reasoning, ethics, or religion in language models.
